tei:div.tei:p: bcom ldan 'das kyi lung rim par bstan te/ bstan pa gtad pa ni| ston pas 'od srung chen po la btad/ de nas rim bzhin du / kun dga' bo dang*/ shā na'i gos can/ nyer rbas/ dhi dhi ka ba tsun pa budhi lan+ti/ budha me/ slob ma dge slong rtsib la/ pu na shā na/ dha skad la de shi sa la des klu 'grub klasgrubablul/ sangs rgyas 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i dus su/ bstan pa btad cing*| khong gi lta ba bstan la 'bebs pa ni/ shing rta chen po'i srol lam dang po gtod de/ de nas yang rim pa bzhin ar+ya de ba/ ma nu ta/ sa bha nan ti/ dge slong dgra bcom gha ya sha ku ma ra dza/ sha ya ta/ ba su ghan tu/ ma nu rta/ ha ka ha na| ya na sha des dge slong seng ka la bstan pa btad cing*/ 'di yan la thub pa chen pos rgyal tshab dang bcas pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de rting sangs rgyas 'das nas lo stong la nye ba na 'phags pa thogs med byon te/ shing rta'i srol lam gnyis pa gtaud cing*/ de nas phyogs kyi glang pos shing rta'i srol lam gsum pa gtod pa lags/ de nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu/ ku su lu rnam gnyis/ mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lags so/ /sangs rgyas shā kya thub pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i zhing khams kyi ming*| stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten zer la/ stong gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ ri rab gling bzhi/ gling phran nyi zla/ lcags ri 'khor yug tshang ba gcig nas bgrang pa'i cha stong la stong chung yang zer la/ stong spyi phud gcig go /de stong la stong gnyis pa bar ma'o/ de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zer ro/ /de rnams re re bgrang na/ ri rab gling bzhi'i tshangs ris man chad bye ba phrag brgya te/ dung phyur gcig go /mi mjed ces bya ba ni/ bzod pa'i ming ste/ pad dkar las nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi mi phrogs shing bzod la/

snying rje pad dkar las/ ci phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya zhe na/ sems can de dag 'dod chags la mi mjed pa dang*/ zhe sdang la mi mjed pa dang*/ gti mug la mi mjed pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams der mi mjed ces bya'o/ /de la sems sran thub pas na/ mi mjed sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zhes bya'o/ /stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing 'di ni/ mnyam du chags par byed do/ /lar thub pa gang chen mtsho'i phyag mnyam bzhag tu mdzad pa'i steng/ lhung zad gyi nang na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams cha nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar yod pa sa / bar pa bcu gsum pa de mi mjaid 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yin par 'dod cing*/ yang lugs gcig la/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams cha lnga lnga dbus dang phyogs rigs bsgrigs pa/ lnga brtseg tu yod pa'i 'askyil kladakyilablum de thub pa'i zhing mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yin par 'dod pa yang yod do// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/bstan pa'i btad rabs kyi skor/ -PAGE 38--PAGE 39-
